title: Evidence-Based Credit Assignment for Search-Augmented Language Models
title_zh: 搜索增强语言模型的基于证据的信用分配
abstract_en: Reinforcement learning from terminal answer rewards enables search-augmented language models to interleave reasoning and retrieval without step-level annotations, yet outcome supervision assigns identical credit to every search in a trajectory regardless of whether it retrieved useful information. This limitation is especially severe when all sampled rollouts for a question fail, collapsing group-centered outcome advantages to zero even when trajectories gather markedly different evidence. We present Evidence-based Credit Assignment (ECA), which augments terminal outcome rewards with a training-only auxiliary signal measuring how retrieved documents improve the likelihood of a reference answer. Rather than scoring the full dialogue prefix, ECA queries a frozen snapshot of the current policy under an evidence-only prompt containing solely the question and the deduplicated documents observed so far, isolating the utility of retrieved passages from surface variations in generated thoughts or search queries. Within this framework, we compare two return formulations, ECA-Step (which accumulates step-clipped potential increments) and ECA-Horizon (which preserves the telescoping horizon gain in potential), paired with cross-fold group normalization, novelty gating, and search-local token assignment. Across seven Search QA benchmarks, ECA-Horizon improves strict macro exact match over an outcome-only GRPO baseline by 1.03 and 4.80 percentage points on Qwen2.5-3B- and 7B-Instruct, respectively, outperforming both RLOO and GiGPO. Zero-shot evaluation on MultiHop-RAG further demonstrates strong transfer to multi-hop inference queries.
abstract_zh: 仅用最终答案奖励进行强化学习，可以让搜索增强语言模型在没有步骤级标注的情况下交替推理与检索，但同一条轨迹中的所有搜索获得相同的信用，无法区分哪些搜索找到了有用证据。当同一问题的所有采样轨迹都答错时，组内中心化后的结果优势会全部归零，即使各轨迹收集到的证据质量明显不同。本文提出 Evidence-based Credit Assignment（ECA），在训练时用检索文档对参考答案似然的提升作为辅助奖励。ECA 用当前策略的冻结快照进行评分，输入只包含问题与截至当前已检索到的去重文档，从而避免生成的推理文本或搜索查询措辞干扰证据评估。论文比较了逐步裁剪并累加势函数增量的 ECA-Step，以及保留整个搜索过程净势增益的 ECA-Horizon。在七个 Search QA 基准上，相比仅使用结果奖励的 GRPO，ECA-Horizon 在 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 和 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上的严格宏平均精确匹配率分别提高 1.03 和 4.80 个百分点，并优于 RLOO 和 GiGPO。在 MultiHop-RAG 上的零样本结果还表明，该方法能迁移到多跳推理问题。
key_points_zh: 仅用最终答案奖励无法区分同一轨迹内各次搜索的贡献；当组内轨迹全部答错时，结果优势全部归零。
ECA 仅在训练时使用辅助奖励：让冻结的策略快照仅根据问题与去重文档评估参考答案的似然，隔离生成的推理文本和查询措辞的影响。
ECA-Step 累加逐步裁剪后的势函数增量；ECA-Horizon 保留整个搜索过程的净势增益。两者均结合跨折组归一化、新颖性门控，并将信用分配给对应搜索的 token。
在七个 Search QA 基准上，ECA-Horizon 相比仅用结果奖励的 GRPO，在 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 和 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上分别提升 1.03 和 4.80 个百分点，并在 MultiHop-RAG 上展现出零样本迁移能力。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 核心贡献是用检索轨迹中的证据效用改进策略更新；七项基准和多个基线支持评估，并为逐步裁剪与保留整段证据增益的回报设计提供比较依据。
